violated_contract: A fork-local security control composed into upstream-owned code (the agent subprocess environment allowlist and the file-based OMI_AUTH_TOKEN delivery) must survive an upstream sync. Resolving a merge by taking upstream's rewritten spawn path wholesale silently reverts the control, and the regression ships if the sync lands without the control's tripwires red-flagging it.
canonical_prevention: Keep source-level tripwire tests (PiMonoWiringTests) asserting the forbidden pattern (whole-environment copy, token directly in child env) and the required pattern (allowlist builder, token file) against the current spawn-path file, and re-point them at the new file whenever upstream moves the spawn path. A sync PR is not landable while these tripwires are red, and an unverified auto-merge to main is not a landing path.
